reasoning_trace: The visual inspection of the hand sanitizer bottle reveals a smooth, clean, nonporous plastic surface, which is highly compatible with the mushroom-tipped gecko-inspired dry-adhesive pads. Because gecko adhesion significantly enhances lifting capability on smooth, clean, nonporous surfaces, the required normal force from the stationary finger to lift the object is low. Without authoritative mass or friction measurements, we rely on a visual approximation of scale (approx 1 L bottle) leading to an estimated weight of around 10 N.
